# Redirected Streamed Request Body Rewind Review

The supplied evidence is insufficient to identify exact source modules, functions, conditions, or test names. It only establishes that the review concerns rewind behavior for redirected streamed request bodies. The following identifies the areas that would need review hypothetically, without treating them as confirmed source facts.

## The preparation state is the primary review point

The preparation state that records whether a streamed request body can be rewound should be reviewed first. A proposed change would verify that this state is established before redirect handling attempts to resend the body and that it remains available across the redirect path.

The supplied evidence does not identify the state variable, its module, its function, or the exact preparation sequence. No source citation is available to confirm those details.

## The redirect condition needs confirmation

The redirect condition governing whether the request body is rewound should also be reviewed. The relevant condition would be the branch that detects a redirect and decides whether the streamed body must be repositioned before the next request is sent.

This is a proposed review target, not an established description of the implementation. The evidence does not specify the redirect status, condition expression, or function location.

## A focused error test should cover failed rewind behavior

A focused error test should verify the behavior when a redirected streamed request body cannot be rewound. The test would need to exercise the redirect path and confirm the expected error rather than silently resending an invalid or partially consumed body.

The supplied evidence does not provide a test name, test module, expected exception, or existing failure report. Those details require the relevant source or test records.

## Facts, proposed changes, and uncertainty remain separate

The only supported fact is that rewind behavior for redirected streamed request bodies is under consideration. Reviewing the preparation state, redirect condition, and focused rewind-error test is a proposed investigation plan rather than a confirmed account of existing code.

No exact module/function locations, source lines, test identifiers, runtime behavior, or evidence citations were supplied. Accordingly, no stronger conclusion is supported by the available snapshot.
